reference_fields: Raspberry Cultivars for the Pacific Northwest
Amanda Davis, Michael Hardigan, Scott Lukas, Patrick Jones, Wendy Hoashi-Erhardt, and Lisa Wasko DeVetter

OSU Extension PNW 655 guide to red, black, yellow-fruited, and purple raspberry cultivars for the Pacific Northwest, with cultivar tables for disease, plant, fruit, yield, use, machine harvest, commercial value, home garden suitability, and cold hardiness

locations.name: Oregon State University Extension Service, Corvallis, Oregon

categories.name: Floricane-fruiting red raspberries for the Pacific Northwest
categories.description: OSU PNW 655 lists these floricane-fruiting red raspberry cultivars in approximate order of ripening for the Pacific Northwest. Commercial value ratings use the source scale where 1 is appropriate for most commercial operations, 2 may have specific commercial value, and 3 is unlikely to have good commercial value
